sloka: विषाणं चास्य निष्कृष्य वालिपुत्रो महाबलः।देवान्तकमभिप्लुत्य ताडयामास संयुगे ।। ६.७०.१५ ।।
transliteration: viṣāṇaṁ cāsya niṣkṛṣya vāliputro mahābalaḥ।devāntakamabhiplutya tāḍayāmāsa saṁyuge ।। 6.70.15 ।।

translations.english: Mighty son of Vali removed the tusk of the elephant and hit Devanthaka with it by jumping over him in the battlefield.
